parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity records for CHEMBL3183703 and all its salt forms against target CHEMBL1741208. First, define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL3183703 to include child salts. Then, retrieve activity provenance using the FAQ join path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Include canonical SMILES via LEFT JOIN compound_structures. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50' and target CHEMBL1741208. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
